  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Breakfast</h3><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Start your day right at Kenyaways with breakfast provided by <a href="https://www.instagram.com/saltysquidkenya/?hl=en">The Salty Squid Bar and Restaurant</a>, offering a wonderful beachfront view. A simple complimentary breakfast is included in all rates except for complimentary stays and children aged 2 and below. You'll find the <a target="_blank" href="/s/2026Salty-Breakfast-menu-Nov25.pdf">breakfast menu</a> in your room, and baby chairs are available upon request. If you're looking for more options, there's a choice of cooked breakfast and other platters available at an extra cost from the menu on the table. If you have an early departure or day trip, you can arrange with The <a href="mailto:saltysquidbar@gmail.com?subject=Enquiry%20for%20Salty%20Squid%20">Salty Squid management</a> to have a picnic breakfast packed for you. </p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">For enquiries, contact Bar Restaurant at +254758515609</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"> Restaurant</h3><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Indulge in a delectable dining experience at The Salty Squid Beach Bar and Restaurant, located beachfront at Kenyaways. Owned and managed externally by Oli and Hal, this restaurant has garnered <a target="_blank" href="https://www.instagram.com/saltysquidkenya/?hl=en">excellent reviews</a>. They take pride in using fresh local organic ingredients, including an abundance of delicious and fresh seafood, offering a wide selection of healthy and reasonably priced dishes. This restaurant is a favourite among our in-house guests and the local Diani Beach community. Please book in advance, especially during lunch and high season. Note that the last food orders are at 9pm, and the bar closes at 9.30pm. Last orders 8.30pm.</p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">For <a href="mailto:saltysquidbar@gmail.com?subject=Salty%20Squid%20Enquiry">reservations and enquiries</a>, contact the restaurant at +254758515609.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Kite storage and assistance</h3></div>


  
<style id="container-styles"></style>

<style id="override-container-styles"></style>
<style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>




</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1668069004986_11145" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1668069004986_11145"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Kenyaways boasts the best kite spot in Diani Beach. Founded by Linzi Kennaway, who started teaching kite surfing in 2004, our beachfront accommodation is inspired by unbeatable kite conditions. Linzi's passion led to the transformation of her family home into a guest house for kite surfers to enjoy the amazing conditions.</p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">All sea view guest rooms offer kite storage outside the rooms, while pool garden rooms have storage near the beachfront. For assistance, rescue, repair, or other kite services, consider H2o Extreme Kite School, conveniently located next foor at <a href="https://www.h2o-extreme.com">www.h2o-extreme.com</a>. Enjoy your Kenya beach getaway with us at this seaside retreat in Kenya.</p></div>
